title: Monthly Sales Ranking
description: Rank salespeople by their monthly sales, including ties, and handle months with no sales.

fixtures.label: Basic dataset
fixtures.description: A few salespeople with regular monthly sales.

fixtures.label: Tied ranks
fixtures.description: Salespeople with equal totals in a month; ranks must be dense.

fixtures.label: Missing months
fixtures.description: A salesperson with zero sales in a month must not appear in that month.
